title: The Unseen Realm: Recovering the Supernatural Worldview of the Bible
description: Heiser's evangelical-scholarly treatment of the divine-council reading of the Hebrew Bible, arguing that the elohim of Psalm 82 and related passages must be read as a real plural — a council of subordinate divine beings under Yahweh. Distinct from the comparative-religious tradition (Smith, Cross) in that Heiser writes from a confessional standpoint while accepting the philological argument for plurality.
